name: Keturah
title: Abraham's concubine
summary: Keturah was a concubine (secondary wife) of Abraham. She became the mother of several sons, including Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Through her, Abraham became the ancestor of several peoples and tribes in the ancient Middle East.

keyEvents.title: Abraham Takes Keturah as Wife
keyEvents.description: After Sarah's death, Abraham took a new wife named Keturah (Rishah), who bore him six sons.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Rishah Are Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Rishah's sons with Abraham were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. These became the ancestors of several peoples.

keyEvents.title: Abraham Sends His Sons Eastward
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave everything he owned to Isaac, but to the sons of his concubines he gave gifts and sent them eastward, away from his son Isaac.

keyEvents.title: Rishah Mentioned as Abraham's Concubine in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Rishah (Keturah) is referred to as Abraham's concubine, and her descendants are listed.
